answer: Make every agent prove its work twice: each completed job earns a pigment fingerprint, a unique mark derived from the job itself and bound to one key, so a copied history shows the same shade twice. A second, unrelated agent must echo the fingerprint by checking the same job, and both marks are sealed inside a velvet vault held by two custodians who never meet. If the echoes diverge, both agents freeze until a rotating audit clears them. Sybil farms must earn a fresh fingerprint, find a new echo partner, and pass fresh custodians for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
